The release, accompanied by a new essay from CEO Mark Zuckerberg, underscores Meta's push for more accessible and customizable AI as low-cost open models from China intensify pressure on rivals including OpenAI and Anthropic. Bloomberg's Kurt Wagner joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: South Park Commons Raises Ambitions for the AI Era
title_cn: South Park Commons 提出人工智能时代的雄心
summary: South Park Commons is expanding its investment strategy as AI pushes founders toward increasingly ambitious and capital-intensive ideas. Co-founder and General Partner Aditya Agarwal joins Bloomberg to discuss the firm’s “minus one to zero” approach to backing entrepreneurs before their ideas fully take shape, why its new fund will allow it to write bigger checks and invest for longer, and how early bets on founders like Cognition CEO Scott Wu are shaping its strategy. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: From Coding to Finance: Microsoft’s AI Agent Push
title_cn: 从编码到金融：微软的AI代理推送

Charles Lamanna, Microsoft EVP of Copilot, Agents and Platform, joins Bloomberg to explain how employees are shifting from doing tasks themselves to overseeing AI agents, why the company sees the technology driving more productivity rather than simply reducing headcount, and what’s behind Microsoft 365 Copilot’s surge past 30 million paid seats. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: GameStop Rethinks Its eBay Play
title_cn: GameStop 重新思考其 eBay 策略
summary: GameStop is considering dropping its bid for eBay and pursuing a partnership instead, according to sources. Bloomberg’s Bailey Lipschultz and Spencer Soper explain how GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen could seek to leverage its 1,600 US stores to give eBay a physical retail presence - and why a partnership may prove more realistic than an outright deal. They join Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Baillie Gifford’s McPadden Backs TSMC, SK Hynix Over China Chips

title_cn: 中国如何才能赢得与美国的人工智能竞赛？

Paulina McPadden, investment manager of International Concentrated Growth Strategy at Baillie Gifford, discusses why she “wouldn’t want to bet against China” and the durable moats she sees at TSMC, SK Hynix and ASML. She also discusses how companies like Shopify and MercadoLibre are emerging as AI beneficiaries outside the semiconductor industry. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

And he has attempted to push another Fed governor, Lisa Cook, from her job.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejected a proposal by US-backed mediators for disarming Hamas, hardening his position after voicing misgivings at the suggestion that Israel reciprocate with phased pullouts from Gaza.
Dan Williams, Bloomberg News Middle East Reporter, discusses the latest moves from conflict in the Middle East. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Ossoff Looks Beyond Senate Foe to Blast Trump in Georgia Speech
title_cn: 奥索夫在佐治亚州的演讲中超越了参议院的敌人抨击特朗普
summary: US Senator Jon Ossoff delivered a blistering attack on Donald Trump from a Black pulpit near Atlanta, casting his gaze beyond his Senate opponent to the US president as the Georgia Democrat campaigns for a second term this November.

title: Ukraine Hits Big Oil Refinery, Petchem Plant Deep in Russia
title_cn: 乌克兰袭击俄罗斯深处的大型炼油厂和石油化工工厂
summary: Ukraine’s military attacked the large Taneco oil refinery and the ZapSibNeftekhim petrochemical plant deep inside Russia on Monday, adding to the pressure on the country’s downstream industry.

title: Trump Adopts 'Low-Key' Approach to Iran Talks
title_cn: 特朗普对伊朗谈判采取“低调”态度
summary: President Donald Trump has shifted from touting an imminent peace deal with Iran to adopting a “low key” attitude to negotiations. Bloomberg's Abeer Abu Omar reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Signals Restraint on Iran, Favors Economic Pressure
title_cn: 特朗普暗示对伊朗实施克制，有利于经济施压
summary: US President Donald Trump signaled he’s prepared to let economic pressure on Iran build rather than launch fresh military strikes to force a reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, even as the Islamic Republic reiterated that the conditions still aren’t in place to allow free passage through the key waterway.

title: Republicans in Congress Face Mountain of To-Dos Before Midterms
title_cn: 国会中的共和党人在中期选举前面临着堆积如山的待办事项
summary: GOP leaders will need to pick and choose how to use limited business days this fall.

title: China Hits US Pecans With 54% Levies Before Xi-Trump Summit
title_cn: 习近平与特朗普峰会前，中国对美国山核桃征收54%的关税
summary: China ordered steep anti-dumping deposits on pecan imports from the US and Mexico, adding another source of trade friction weeks before an expected summit between President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping.
